record.original_question: For all sufficiently large n, is the n-vertex planar 3-uniform hypergraph with maximum spectral radius uniquely the one whose shadow graph is K_2 joined with P_{n-2}?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6 (Ellingham-Lu-Wang [52]). For large enough n, the n-vertex planar 3-uniform hypergraph of maximum spectral radius is the unique hypergraph whose shadow is K2 ∨ Pn−2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let H be a 3-uniform hypergraph on n vertices, i.e., V(H) is a finite set of size n and E(H) is a collection of 3-element subsets of V(H). The shadow (2-section) of H is the simple graph G on the same vertex set V(H) in which two distinct vertices u,v are adjacent if and only if {u,v} is contained in some edge of H. Call H planar if its shadow graph is planar.

The spectral radius ρ(H) of H is defined as the spectral radius of its adjacency tensor A(H), namely the largest value λ for which there exists a nonnegative, nonzero vector x ∈ R^n with (A(H) x^2)_i = λ x_i^2 for every i ∈ V(H), where (A(H) x^2)_i = Σ_{{i,j,k} ∈ E(H)} 2 x_j x_k.

For graphs F and G on disjoint vertex sets, the join F ∨ G is the graph obtained from the disjoint union of F and G by adding every edge between V(F) and V(G). Let K_2 denote the complete graph on 2 vertices and P_{n-2} the path on n-2 vertices. Let H* denote the unique 3-uniform hypergraph on n vertices whose shadow equals K_2 ∨ P_{n-2} and whose edge set consists of all triples {u,v,w} ⊆ V that span a triangle in K_2 ∨ P_{n-2}.

Prove or disprove: there exists n_0 such that for every integer n ≥ n_0, among all planar 3-uniform hypergraphs on n vertices, H* is the unique hypergraph attaining the maximum value of ρ(·).
artifact.status_search_result: A survey on spectral theory of hypergraphs (2025) describes Ellingham–Lu–Wang's result for the outer-planar case and lists the planar 3-uniform analogue as an open conjecture. No paper found that resolves the planar case.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Theory of Hypergraphs: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Ellingham, Lu and Wang have characterized the 3-uniform outer-planar hypergraph attaining the maximum value of the largest eigenvalue and they posed a conjecture for 3-uniform planar hypergraphs.
status_evidence.claim: The planar version of the Ellingham–Lu–Wang spectral extremal conjecture is stated as an open conjecture in a recent survey.
